_README: SYNTHESIZED, NOT A SNAPSHOT. Every entry below exists because someone
decided that SHAPE matters to _graphSrc. There is no real card text here:
no agent ids, host names, project names or titles written by people who
were not writing for publication. scitex-cards' ruling (2026-08-15): a
test fixture is a permanent, copied, greppable artefact, and 'it is just a
test fixture' is how data ends up somewhere nobody audits.
WHY SYNTHESIZED BEATS A SCRUBBED REAL SUBSET, and this is the deciding
reason rather than the privacy one: A REAL SNAPSHOT GOES STALE INVISIBLY.
It looks authoritative forever, so nobody asks whether it still represents
the store. This file WEARS ITS ASSUMPTIONS ON ITS FACE — a reader can read
the list and notice what is MISSING.
THE DISCIPLINE THAT KEEPS IT HONEST, and it is not optional: a synthesized
fixture can only hold shapes someone THOUGHT OF, and real data eventually
produces one nobody did. So WHEN A SHAPE-RELATED BUG IS FOUND IN
PRODUCTION, THE FIX ADDS THAT SHAPE HERE. This then becomes a growing
record of every shape that has ever mattered, which beats a snapshot of one
Tuesday.
Volume is deliberately absent. The builders branch on shape; 4,488 rows
exercise each branch many times and add no coverage past the first. The
volume only ever demonstrated the mermaid size ceiling, which has its own
card and its own reproduction.

_shapes_covered.id-needs-sanitising: clew-spec-v0.2 — a dot, which _esc rewrites to _. Dots are the ONLY escaped character on the real board (14 of 4,517 ids, all version numbers), measured 2026-08-15.
_shapes_covered.id-collision-under-esc: clew-spec-v0_2 alongside clew-spec-v0.2 — both escape to the same mermaid id, so one node is drawn for two cards. Real, silent, and the reason stats.nodes counts DISTINCT ESCAPED IDS rather than cards (#853/#857).
_shapes_covered.title-with-quotes-and-brackets: _safe strips [ ] and " to spaces — they terminate a mermaid label.
_shapes_covered.blocks-edge: kind=blocks — same arrow direction, server already orients it.
_shapes_covered.parent-edge: a separate axis, NOT in edges[]; drawn dashed.
_shapes_covered.self-parent: p !== t.id guard — a card parented to itself must not draw a loop.
_shapes_covered.parent-outside-the-visible-set: visibleIds guard — a dangling parent must not draw an edge to nothing.
_shapes_covered.edge-touching-an-invisible-card: same guard on the edges[] axis.
_shapes_covered.disconnected-card: no edge touches it, so it is NOT drawn and only ever counted.
_shapes_covered.status-variety: each node carries its RAW status class st-<status>, no 4-bucket collapse.
_shapes_covered.project-prefix:
the label is `project.slice(0,18)
...`; a card with no project renders the em-dash.
_shapes_covered.project-over-18-chars: the 18-char slice on the project half of the label.
_shapes_covered.task-overrides-title: the label reads `t.task || t.title` — task wins where both exist.
_shapes_covered.status-with-stripped-characters: the class is `st-` + status with /[^a-z_]/gi removed, so digits and hyphens vanish from the CLASS while the card keeps its status.
_shapes_covered.status_colors-present-and-dashed: classDefs come from the SSOT status_colors projected into the payload, never a second colour table; `dashed` adds a stroke-dasharray.
_shapes_covered.status-failed-and-cancelled-are-present-: they sit on the self-parented and orphan-parent cards, so they are counted and never drawn — which is itself the behaviour under test.
